confidence_notes: FX comes from an RBA search result: the 18 Nov 2026 4pm USD rate was 0.6720 USD per AUD. I did not open the RBA page myself. Food and drink anchors draw on one cost-of-living search, which returned Traveltables (last updated July 2023) and MyLifeElsewhere (mid-2026 update). Beer, cappuccino and the inexpensive meal are reasonably supported. I adjusted them upward for tourist-zone pricing. The midrange meal is based on the Traveltables figure of about $62, adjusted upward. No cocktail price was found, so I estimated it at roughly 2.5x beer. Wine by the glass is estimated from a mid-range bottle price of about $6 plus a restaurant markup. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge and the supplied city context. I did not search for accommodation prices. Punta Cana accommodation is dominated by resorts, so hostel and budget hotel supply is thin and prices vary widely by season. The July 2026 window is low season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Caribbean and Mexican beach resort areas, such as Playa del Carmen, with a tourist-priced premium over the rest of the Dominican Republic.
